It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Crest-Voland's altitude (1230 m at the base, 2066 m at the top) helps it keep a decent snow cover in midwinter. The 41€ day lift pass places Crest-Voland among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and facilities justifies this price for most skiers.
